$comment.repo: owner/name on GitHub — where every issue, label, and Project lives.
$comment.project: Projects v2 project NUMBER (not id). Placeholder below — VERIFY/replace once the real Project exists (see docs/DASHBOARD.md).
$comment.labels: Namespace -> literal label prefix bugflow writes as '<prefix>:<value>'. Customize the prefix text if a repo wants it; the namespaces themselves are fixed by docs/DATA-MODEL.md.
$comment.carveOut: Regex source strings (case-insensitive), copied verbatim from scripts/campaign/bugs.mjs's classify()/SENSITIVE in the current registry (on master since #597). Tested against title + the joined `## Files` list only — bugflow has no `location` field, which deliberately widens the ported classify() surface (title + location). A bug may carry more than one class label: 1 agent-safe, or 1-3 carve-out classes, never both — see docs/DATA-MODEL.md.
$comment.hubFiles: Static allow-list of god-files excluded from hard-conflict detection in `bugflow plan` (docs/PLANNING.md). Unlike bugs.mjs's dynamic frequency threshold, this is a plain list a human edits by hand as the codebase changes.
$comment.areas: Path glob -> area label. First match wins, so order matters — put specific globs before general ones. Drawn from this repo's own CLAUDE.md Architecture section. `unknown` is a reserved area with no glob of its own — assigned when a legacy import or triage has no `## Files` to match against; the nightly triage routine sweeps it once files are known.
$comment.automation: The owner kill switch (RUNBOOK.md's pause-all-automation procedure) — every `bugflow next` call reads this fresh, so flipping `enabled` to false pauses every seat immediately, including a worker mid-run.
$comment.seats: GitHub login -> allowedClasses + dailyClaimCap, for FLEET seats only. A human's own interactive session is never listed here — the carve-out gates unattended automation, not humans (docs/CLAIMS-AND-LEASES.md).
$comment.lease: Claim lease duration in minutes — unchanged from scripts/team/team.mjs's LEASE_MINUTES.
$comment.harness: Routing thresholds for the cheap, capped Ralph tier vs. the full bug-pipeline tier — see docs/HARNESS.md.
$comment.proof: The REG token grammar `bugflow check` matches — REG-#N for bugs filed directly in bugflow, REG-B### preserved for bugs imported from the legacy registry.
$comment.snapshot: Where `bugflow snapshot` commits its offline export — see docs/DATA-MODEL.md's snapshot formats.
$comment.privacy: The client-identifier denylist itself is NEVER written into this file or this repo — only the name of the environment variable `bugflow sync` reads it from at run time, from a private source.
$comment.deploy: The GitHub deployment environment and check-run names `bugflow verify` reads for post-deploy proof.
